data.description: In ProductionBatchRunner's project-criterion resolution (the project.-prefixed activated overlay criteria path, _project_criteria/route_criteria re-route), under PROBE MODE (drift-refresh) the built-in set is the tiny probe allowlist (E4+G1G2), but route_criteria has no probe notion, so an activated project criterion is ALSO evaluated during a probe. Harmless today (the drift comparison keys off E4/G1G2), but a future change should thread the probe allowlist into this routing to suppress evaluating activated project criteria during a probe. Discovered while triaging comments in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py (ticket ad16).
data.title: plan-review: thread probe allowlist into project-criterion routing (drift-refresh)
